content.short: DRPC is a decentralized RPC network delivering reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient blockchain node access for developers on Mantle.
content.description: DRPC (Decentralized RPC) is a blockchain node access network that connects dApp developers to an independent network of third-party node operators and public nodes. The platform intelligently routes API requests to the most performant and geographically relevant nodes, offering enterprise-grade uptime without centralized dependency risks. DRPC supports Mantle Network with dedicated endpoints and offers a competitive free tier alongside enterprise plans, making it an attractive choice for both indie developers and large teams building on Mantle.
